title: Synthetic before-tool callback guardrail design
raw_text: Review a runner-wide before-tool callback guardrail that allows approved synthetic operations, blocks denied operations before Tool execution, writes a redacted decision to state and audit evidence, and fails closed on callback errors. Do not scaffold runnable source until callback runtime semantics are implemented and verified.
business_goal: Review the callback guardrail boundary and preserve a fail-closed generation stop until the generic runtime generator supports its semantics.
current_process: Continue to the Tool only for an allowed decision
Return a typed blocked result without invoking the Tool for a denied or failed decision
Write only a redacted decision to synthetic state and audit evidence
